title: ScipSymbolContribution
description: Mirror of one element of `Document.symbols[]` (per-document `SymbolInformation`) from an SCIP index (https://github.com/sourcegraph/scip). The 'symbolInformation' field is passed through verbatim. Symbols defined OUTSIDE the indexed project (JDK, libraries) live in the sibling slot `Index.ScipExternalSymbol` (no `scipDocumentRelativePath`). Per-token positional references to this symbol live in `Index.ScipOccurrence`. identityKey: composite `(scipDocumentRelativePath, symbolInformation.symbol)`. Downstream KSs filter by `symbolInformation.kind` to scope class / method / field / type-parameter / local. Do not remap fields here; track upstream SCIP schema evolution. Field-name convention: keys within `symbolInformation` MUST follow SCIP proto3 canonical-JSON camelCase encoding (e.g. `displayName`, `signatureDocumentation`); producers emitting snake_case MUST normalize before contribution.

scipDocumentRelativePath.description: Repo-relative POSIX path of the SCIP Document containing this symbol (i.e. the .java/.kt source file).

symbolInformation.description: Verbatim SCIP SymbolInformation as JSON. Required keys per SCIP spec: 'symbol' (the SCIP symbol id). Other keys (kind, displayName, signature_documentation, relationships, documentation, ...) preserved as-is. additionalProperties: true to absorb upstream additions.

scipIndexerVersion.description: Version string of the SCIP indexer that produced the record (e.g. scip-java, scip-typescript). Optional; useful for replay diagnostics.
